title: 八重の勝利は無敵の証

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Yaeno Muteki and I are going to be interviewed by Reporter Etsuko Otonashi.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: How incredible!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You wanted to challenge the Eternal Top Three in order to prove that you're the star of your generation?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: And you've defeated them so many times! You've really stuck to your word—simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Who would have thought that would be the motivation behind your legacy!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But wouldn't it be better for you to express this to the world directly? I don't think this kind of passion can be communicated through writing alone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how Yaeno Muteki came to have this in-person event hosted by Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My desire to surpass the Eternal Top Three has driven me forward single-mindedly, and before I realized it, I had accumulated win after win.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! So you want to be the star of your generation! But of course you would, you're Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're already the star of your generation! Just look at how many times you've defeated the Eternal Top Three—you're totally unbeatable!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Me? Unbeatable?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: That's right! All those wins are proof that no one holds a candle to you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan D
text_block_list.text: Keep on dominating out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Muteki! Muteki! Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh my!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Calls of Muteki's name echo throughout the room. All of a sudden, I'm struck by the sensation of being at a racecourse…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Yaeno Muteki standing in the winner's circle and the audience screaming her name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Muteki! Muteki! Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is what I've wanted for so long…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: This? …Oh, you mean cheers like Oguri gets?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've been aiming to give such a race that I would enchant people the way she does. I believe she has the presence befitting a true star of one's generation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Just winning isn't enough. In that respect, I still haven't surpassed Oguri or the others.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must continue working hard until I can run in a way that's becoming of the star of my generation and peak of racing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Then, we're with you! If there's anything we can do to help, we'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Oguri's fan base wasn't built overnight either! It grew one person at a time! So if we focus our energies on supporting you, we can do something!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan D
text_block_list.text: Let's make a Yaeno Muteki fan club! That way all us fans can keep in easy contact!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: We'll do whatever we can to help you, Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm so incredibly happy! Thank you all from the very bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The event is a great success. The fans leave in groups, still excitedly chatting amongst themselves.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I can't believe the people who support me are so passionate!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's why something inside is burning so hot now. I can feel my hunger for competition raging within me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This must be how Oguri feels when she converts her fans' support into power…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… Being able to fill the stands is wonderful, but there's something great about sharing a strong bond with your supporters as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I feel truly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki smiles joyfully. It seems her countless victories have rewarded her with a priceless connection to her fans.
